fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: A human-readable description of the rule.

fields.label: Enable
fields.help: Indicates whether or not this packet mirroring takes effect.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name of the packet mirroring rule

fields.label: Priority
fields.help: Since only one rule can be active at a time, priority is used to break ties in the case of two rules that apply to the same instances.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: The Region in which the created address should reside.

fields.label: Collector Ilb
URL
fields.help: The URL of the forwarding rule.
The Forwarding Rule resource (of type load_balancing_scheme=INTERNAL) that will be used as collector for mirrored traffic.

fields.label: Filter
Cidr Ranges
fields.help: IP CIDR ranges that apply as a filter on the source (ingress) or destination (egress) IP in the IP header.

fields.label: Direction
fields.help: Direction of traffic to mirror.

fields.label: IP Protocols
fields.help: Possible IP protocols including tcp, udp, icmp and esp
A filter for mirrored traffic.

fields.label: Mirrored Resources
Tags
fields.help: All instances with these tags will be mirrored.

fields.label: Instances
URL
fields.help: The URL of the instances where this rule should be active.
All the listed instances will be mirrored.

fields.label: Subnetworks
URL
fields.help: The URL of the subnetwork where this rule should be active.
All instances in one of these subnetworks will be mirrored.
A means of specifying which resources to mirror.

fields.label: Network
URL
fields.help: The full self_link URL of the network where this rule is active.
Specifies the mirrored VPC network.
